assessment: This important work proposes a novel approach, based on co-evolution analysis, machine-learning protocols, and molecular dynamics simulations, to predict structures and energetics of the main states of the alternating access cycle of a family of membrane transporters, the sugar porters. The approach is compelling, especially the application of co-evolution and Alphafold to generate accurate models in different conformational states of a given protein, and will be of interest to the membrane transport and computational modeling communities.
